description: Quarterly US real GDP and unemployment for full-sample and rolling linear OLS.

real_gdp.units: Billions of chained 2017 dollars, seasonally adjusted annual rate

unemployment.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of all three months; incomplete quarters are not averaged.

missing_data.October_2025: Not collected by BLS; 2025Q4 excluded, no imputation.

transformations: change_u = difference of quarterly unemployment rate, in percentage points

paper.title: Okun's Law: Fit at 50?
paper.scope: Teaching adaptation of the changes equation, not an exact replication.

scope: Teaching application for Tutorial IV, with included data; the fuller original is retained outside the student folder.

model.covariance: HAC, Bartlett weights, four quarterly lags, finite-sample correction, approximate t inference
